note.p: Children of William Nicholson: Sarah 1782(mentioned on her own 20 and 24 Oct 1802, 7 Feb 1804; 6 March 1807; 21 and 22 May 1807 - and see below); Anne 1784;(mentioned on Dec 2, 1804) Robert +/or Mary 1787; William 1789; John 1791 (mentioned 29 May 1807) and twice in June 1815 after his father's death; Catherine, 1795; Charlotte 1797 (Mentioned 16 Nov 1813); Martha May 1799; plus Isaac and two others. Source, Sue Durrell's ed. of the Life of William Nicholson, by his son William Nicholson. The diary also identifies a Geo[rge] Nicholson, in a call on 18 November 1801; 2 miss Nicholsons (1 October 1799; 11 January 1802). There are also entries for A, S and M Nicholson (24 April 1805); S and M Nicholson (20 April 1805); S and A Nicholson (1 January 1807). We have not coded P Nicholson as part of the family - this looks more like someone Godwin is trying to enlist in his son William's education or employment.
